Info.title: POD model
Info.desc: Global POD basis of the full-field snapshots of the training boards on the superset grid of all layouts, Galerkin projection of every test board (studyPFHB.runPOD)
Info._note: Edit the values only. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored. 'CHANGE' marks parameters that depend on the computer (GPU memory, runtime); all other values are those of the paper.

Mdl._energy: Energy: rank r: smallest number of POD modes that hold this fraction of the snapshot energy (sum of the squared singular values)
Mdl._rMax: Maximum rank: upper limit of the rank r
